parameter_matrix.note: Synchronous rectification eliminates external Schottky diode loss and PCB area.
Compact WSON/VSON/SOT-563 packages demand tight hot-loop layout and thermal vias.
A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Provides transient overshoot margin above nominal DC supply bus.
Fixed-output variants save divider BOM; adjustable parts allow arbitrary rail tuning up to switch BVdss limits.
Continuous DC output current rating; verify inductor Isat >= Iout + ΔIL/2 and thermal margin.

swap_risks: CRITICAL OUTPUT VOLTAGE RAIL MISMATCH: AP63203WU-7 is a fixed 3.3 V converter (vout_nom_v, p.5) whereas AP63205WU-7 is a fixed 5 V converter (vout_nom_v, p.5); swapping delivers the wrong rail voltage and can destroy downstream loads.
BENCH VERIFICATION: Confirm thermal dissipation margin using θJA (AP63203WU-7: 89 °C/W vs AP63205WU-7: 89 °C/W) and worst-case ambient temperature (-40..85 °C vs -40..85 °C).
engineering_verdict: AP63203WU-7 (Diodes Incorporated, TSOT-23-6) and AP63205WU-7 (Diodes Incorporated, TSOT-23-6) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to fixed DC-DC output voltage rail mismatch (3.3 V vs 5 V). Power-stage deltas: buck (sync) vs buck (sync), switching frequency 1100 kHz (p.5) vs 1100 kHz (p.5) (1x ratio), typical inductor 3.9 µH (p.13) vs 4.7 µH (p.13), output mode fixed vs fixed, and package θJA 89 vs 89 °C/W. Primary bench gotchas to watch: AP63203WU-7 "CRITICAL PINOUT TRAP: Completely Incompatible With TPS54302DDCR, TPS563201DDCR & AP62200WU-7!" (p.1) and AP63205WU-7 "Pin-Identical Fixed 5.0 V vs 3.3 V Overvoltage Hazard — AP63205WU-7 ('T5') vs AP63203WU-7 ('T4')" (p.2). BOM decision: Choose AP63203WU-7 when matching your existing Diodes Incorporated TSOT-23-6 (TSOT26) qualification and -40..85 °C grade; choose AP63205WU-7 when matching your existing Diodes Incorporated TSOT-23-6 (TSOT26 (WU)) qualification and -40..85 °C grade. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.1) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
